utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great — it’s on Sunday at the community center, right? I can help spread the word if you need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, Sunday at the community center sounds right — and thanks, that’d be a big help spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — happy to spread the word. If you want, I can mention Sunday at the community center to my neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—I haven’t checked yet, sorry. I’m a bit forgetful, but I can ask around and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries at all — I heard they’re getting more donations than expected, so they may just need a quick check on what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I’ll ask around and see what’s still missing. If you hear anything specific, let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only caught bits of it, so I’m not sure what they still need. If you know, I’d be glad to pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Nell. If you hear the time or location, please pass it along—I’m trying to work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing—I’ll ask around and pass along the time and location if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Late works for me—just knock softly and we’ll keep it easy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Uli — I’ll keep it quiet and easy. I’ll swing by late and help with whatever’s simplest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. See you late, and we’ll keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: What time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, what time is the repair drive happening and where should people drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on the time and drop-off spot—do you have a plan in mind?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I haven’t checked the list yet, but I can swing by and see what’s still needed for the repair drive. Just let me know what tools you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus — I’m still short on a hammer, screwdriver set, and a drill if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a hammer and screwdriver set I can bring by, and I’ll check whether I can spare a drill too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon. If you want, I can help spread the word a little.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m already telling folks, but the more the better. I’ll spread the word around the neighborhood right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’m glad to help however I can. If you need me to tell a few more neighbors, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Mostly the cracks near the edge—if you’ve got any filler or patch mix, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep track of the patch mix too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still in, I just need the exact drop-off spot confirmed first. Do we know where the repair drive is collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — it’s at the community center on Sunday now, not the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — the community center on Sunday works for me. I just wanted to be sure before I bring anything by.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive and help out for a bit. I’ll tell the others too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive today. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — if you make it, great. I’ll be there for a bit, and I’ll let the others know too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I did—what are we still short on for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on hammer heads and a few rolls of strong tape. If you can find those nails too, that’d really round us out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — hammer heads, strong tape, and nails. I’ll see what I can bring by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — if you can, please ask what items are still needed and when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I can ask around for that—what items are still needed and when it’s happening. I’ll see what I can find out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — I’d really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’m still planning to swing by the repair drive for a bit, and I’ll remind the others too. Once the drop-off spot’s confirmed, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. Just let me know when the drop-off spot’s confirmed, and I’ll be there with the cracked edge info.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — as soon as it’s confirmed, I’ll let you and the others know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive—sounds like it’s getting a few more donations than expected. I’m a bit forgetful, but I can help keep an eye out for anything they still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Oren. I’ll try to swing by later if I remember.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — no rush, and I’ll keep an eye out too. Just let me know if you hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — the community hall bulletin board works for the repair drive details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll post the details there and bring any filler or patch mix I can find for those edge cracks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — the bulletin board should do. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you confirm what else we still need, especially for the gate or faucet, and let me know the exact time when you have it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check on what’s still needed for the gate or faucet and get the exact time for you. I’ll let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll wait for your update on the gate or faucet needs and the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits from the neighbors, so I’m not totally sure. Do you know what they still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know a little myself, but I can help spread the word if that’d be useful. If you hear a list of what’s needed, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be helpful. I’ll ask around and let you know if I hear what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I might be a little late, but I can still swing by and lend a hand at the repair drive. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s Sunday at the community center now. If you can, just bring whatever tools you’ve got handy and I’ll note it down.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll bring whatever tools I’ve got and head to the community center as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve been keeping an eye on the repair drive supplies, so tell me what you still need and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 4 works for me. Just let me know if the repair drive location changes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure thing — I’ll let you know if anything changes, and I’ll check we’ve got the 4 covered.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got my tools set aside for the repair drive. Just tell me what you still need, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — the tools are covered, so we’re in good shape there. If you can, could you also help coordinate who’s dropping things off?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can help with that. Just send me the list of who’s dropping things off, and I’ll coordinate it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday and help a little, keeping it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Uli — thank you. Just drop by the community center on Sunday whenever you’re able.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll do my best to stop by Sunday whenever I can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you get a chance to check what still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, I just want to make sure the drop-off spot and timing are confirmed first. Do we know exactly where the repair drive is collecting everything?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m checking on that now — once I confirm the drop-off spot and time, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll ask around and see what’s still needed, plus when it’s happening. If I hear anything new, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s actually happening today, then? I just want to make sure before I bring anything over.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m checking now, but I haven’t confirmed the time yet—better to hold off just a bit until I hear for sure.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, that repair drive? I heard it’s picking up a few more donations than expected. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira—just let me know the time and any needs, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing — I’ll keep an ear out and tell you as soon as I hear what time they’re sorting donations or if they need more help.
